research_question: Does the native numerical causal weight writer learn unfamiliar 64-variable nonlinear intervention consequences under 1024 observations per world, and at what earlier observation prefix does it meet >=95% exact heldout full-state accuracy without underperforming an exact symbolic control? High-first capacity is maintained, while 16 worlds are safely distributed across eight separately qualified read-only parallel shards to eliminate wall-time censoring.
hypothesis: A new isolated 64-node cohort can be evaluated without modifying the native learning mechanism or lowering the test difficulty, if we shard whole worlds and preseal each world's all-arm actions and predictions before reading its heldout labels. Empirical superiority remains null unless it actually beats the exact symbolic controls.

primary.domain_separator: New hidden generator and heldout namespace WSP115|*|v2 (not WSP114|*|v1); all 16 worlds new; old WSP114 v1 first use remains consumed and may not be rerun, inspected or score-tuned.
primary.same_science: Use exact same native.py and controls.py as WSP114 at pinned SHA. Preserve 64-node causal XOR+quadratic 12-parent window and generic GF2 solver, 5 arms/direct/symbolic/ridge/random/passive + direct-action matched symbolic, zero memory and pair ablation. No reduction of observations, world count, heldout size or control strength.
primary.parallelization: Exactly eight matrix jobs each handles two worlds. Each shard must be immutable-source read-only, separately emit a SHA256 seal over all 2-world, all-arm, all-prefix transcripts and predictions before opening any heldout labels for its own two worlds. No model or configuration updates across shards, no result-dependent adaptive reconfiguration, and no shared learner state. All eight world cohorts independent under new SHA256 namespace.
primary.train: 32 synthetic public fully observed linear-only worlds x256 state/action observations each; common source all arms; original quadratic transfer novel within same feature grammar
primary.scoring: Each shard outputs a complete, self-contained JSON receipt including world IDs, all 8 exact prefix accuracy counts for each control and direct, per-world accuracy, cold restoration and tamper, source pin, train evidence SHA and wall/CPU diagnostics. Cross-shard aggregate uses exactly weighted counts, not averages over rounded percentages. If any shard times out, fails or has mismatched immutable SHA, mark the full scientific outcome incomplete; no cherry-picked aggregate.
primary.conditional_backoff: Start 64 and 1024 only. At aggregate >=95% exact heldout, report smallest qualified prefix 1024→8 with <=1pp accuracy deficit vs strongest independent exact symbolic. If 64 primary misses >=95% then a new separately preregistered capacity backoff may use independent new 48-node then 32-node worlds; no 48/32 test runs before 64 primary result. No unqualified adaptive cohort.

metrics.primary: 16-world/8192-query exact 64bit whole-state heldout accuracy at 1024 interventions with independent exact GF2 symbolic as strongest control, also same-action symbolic, prereg 95% absolute accuracy gate, exact 2pp superiority gate
metrics.secondary: The original every-prefix 1024,512,256,128,64,32,16,8 full-state exact and per-bit accuracy, rank distributions, direct synapse cold replay, invalid checkpoint tamper rejection, zero-memory/pair-ablation and passive/random negatives. Record per-world and per-shard, not just global.
metrics.limitations: Prerecorded WSP114 evaluation does NOT compute full preregistered graph coefficient recall, chained rollout, calibrated per-arm process peak memory or independently replicated 2x runtime; WSP115 preserves the explicitly implemented narrower DEV metrics. NEVER relabel these missing science metrics complete. Resource measures will not qualify 2x superiority until new matched end-to-end independent qualifier.
metrics.stop: Any one missing shard, failure, timeout, inconsistent receipts or source drift -> INCOMPLETE; never fill a missing shard with rerun against the same partially consumed original cohort. Repair only under new preregistered independent seeds/qualified follow-up. Do not infer learning FAIL from infrastructure cancellation.
